b10c:

Prefilling this transaction likely wouldn’t make sense as it’s too large.

Does that make sense? I think if we had a 999kB coinbase tx we would prefill it, despite it being large. cf Stats on compact block reconstructions - #45 by davidgumberg - Protocol Design - Delving Bitcoin perhaps, which proposed for HB peers to prefill txs they expect the recipient doesn’t have in ways that reduce overlap.
